column1: # What the pets know about Lotus – told to them when they talk and when they help with /help.
# One line per feature (its id from data/features.tsv), then a tab and what a pet knows; only the lines of features
# that are on are used. Keep each line short: the pet's AI can be a small one. New things belong here too.

column2: Lotus is the start screen and command center of this terminal. /help: a pet asks what you need and shows the commands. /settings changes everything (theme, name, logo, features). Logos: Lotus, Apple, Flag of Earth or your own, in the theme's colors (a gradient through them) or their own. /lotus cheatsheet lists every command, /clock shows a clock, lotus update gets the newest Lotus.
/app <name> opens an app, typos are fine. /install shows good apps by category and installs them.
/brew <words> searches Homebrew and installs what you choose.
/search and /google search the web, /web opens a site, a pasted link opens in the browser.
/weather [city] shows the weather with ASCII art and three days ahead.

/ai opens the AI terminal: it chats, writes code, creates and changes files and asks first; for bigger tasks it makes a plan and works through it step by step. In /ai, /effort sets how hard it thinks, up to ultra, and /performance writes a report. /ai server opens the same AI as a web chat in the browser, with an effort slider and a code panel to read, copy and download code. lotus ai local runs a model on this Mac; lotus ai local restart starts it again.
/np shows what is playing; /play, /pause, /skip, /back control it. While a song plays, its album cover replaces the logo on the start screen.
/lotus visual shows an animated audio visualizer.
/convert <link> saves a video as MP3 or MP4.
/ios has tools for iPhones and iPads.
/minecraft sets up a Minecraft server step by step.
/bg remove takes the background off an image on this Mac – drag the image into the window.
Type a pet's name to talk to it; /feed <name> feeds it; /pets to adopt up to three. Pets come along into /ai.
/caffeine keeps the Mac awake for a while.

Plugins add commands, AI tools and start screen lines. /plugin installer: drag plugin folders or packs into the window, or paste a GitHub link. A plugin pack is a GitHub repository that installs several plugins at once, with their settings. /plugin new makes your own plugin, /plugin pack shares yours as a pack, /plugin uninstall removes them again, /plugin lists them.
